description.narrative: DNDi is committed to developing safe, effective, and affordable treatments for people with neglected tropical diseases and for neglected patients. Since 2003, DNDi has worked with its worldwide network of partners to develop a total of 12 new treatments for 6 deadly diseases.
DNDi’s objective is to deliver 25 new treatments for neglected patients by 2028.

sector.code: 3.3.5 NUMBER OF PEOPLE REQUIRING INTERVENTIONS AGAINST NEGLECTED TROPICAL DISEASES

policy-marker.narrative: Deliver 25 new treatments for neglected patients in DNDi first 25 years.
